description: A table, view or search index in a table lineage graph.

id.description: The id of the object, with its version when the dependency is pinned to a version (e.g. 'syn123' or 'syn123.4').

access.description: What the caller may see of this object.

name.description: The name of the object. Only included when access is READABLE.

concreteType.description: The concrete type of the entity (e.g. org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.table.MaterializedView). Only included when access is READABLE.

tableState.description: The current state of the object's index. Not included when the object has no index status yet, or access is not READABLE.

stateChangedOn.description: When the object's index state last changed. A materialized view that is already AVAILABLE stays AVAILABLE while it rebuilds and only this time advances, when the rebuilt index replaces the old one. Only included with tableState.

errorMessage.description: When tableState is PROCESSING_FAILED, the reason the index could not be built.

isStale.description: True when the object is AVAILABLE but one of its sources in this graph changed after it was last built, or is being rebuilt, or is itself stale: the object will be rebuilt and its index does not yet reflect that change. Only sources the caller can read are considered. Only included with tableState.
